nodes.id: Subtopic:Environment|Climate action|Ocean acidification|Influence on marine biodiversity_qna_000
nodes.label: Facts
nodes.question: What ecological aspect has been documented to be adversely affected by eutrophication?
nodes.answer: Eutrophication has been widely documented to adversely affect species richness in plants.

nodes.id: Subtopic:Environment|Climate action|Ocean acidification|Influence on marine biodiversity_qna_001
nodes.label: Facts
nodes.question: What factors have contributed to the decline of Gongolaria barbata?
nodes.answer: The decline has been attributed to severe repeated anoxic crises (mala gues) and competition with exotic flora introduced from the NE Atlantic and NW Pacific, particularly the invasive Sargassum muticum.

nodes.id: Subtopic:Environment|Climate action|Ocean acidification|Influence on marine biodiversity_qna_002
nodes.label: Conservation
nodes.question: What are the main possible causes of decline for G. barbata populations?
nodes.answer: The main possible causes of decline for G. barbata populations are uprooting, overgrazing by herbivores, habitat destruction, and competition with introduced seaweeds.

nodes.id: Subtopic:Environment|Climate action|Ocean acidification|Influence on marine biodiversity_qna_003
nodes.label: Analysis
nodes.question: What are the effects of edge conditions on epifaunal and infaunal communities?
nodes.answer: Edge conditions lead to greater exposure to predators and environmental stress for epifaunal and infaunal communities, resulting in behavioral and physiological changes, shifts in species richness, abundance, and community dynamics.

nodes.id: Subtopic:Environment|Climate action|Ocean acidification|Influence on marine biodiversity_qna_004
nodes.label: Science and tech
nodes.question: How does nitrogen enrichment affect bryophyte cover and species richness according to the study?
nodes.answer: Nitrogen enrichment directly reduces bryophyte cover and species richness, possibly due to toxic effects.
